title: WhisperReply
description: Client sided mod that lets you run a short command to reply to the latest whisper you recieved.
body:
# QuickReply

Tired of typing out `/msg <PlayerName> <message>` just to reply to a whisper? **QuickReply** adds a simple `/re <message>` command that instantly replies to the last player who messaged you.

![chat preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7d3da8723ae556468721ded90e8423e5e4af7fe2.png)

---

## ✉️ Features

- Reply to the latest `/msg` / whisper with a single command
- Completely **client-sided**
- Lightweight and straightforward

---

## 📋 Command

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/re <message>` | Reply to the last player who messaged you |

---

## ⚠️ Compatibility Warning

This mod is designed for players on **vanilla or vanilla+** servers that don't already offer a reply command.

**This mod is NOT guaranteed to work on every server.** Servers running chat decoration plugins, nickname plugins, or custom chat formatting may break the reply detection. There's simply no way to account for every possible direct message format out there.

---

## 🔧 Requirements

- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
